name: Dakota County, MN
findings: Dakota County has 1,403 nonprofit organizations. 616 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 496 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Dakota County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Dakota County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Few youth organizations list public events
observations.text: 6 youth organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 17 would.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for public events through youth groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Arts and cultural organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 24 arts and cultural organizations here list public events, compared with about 11 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do arts and cultural organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 98 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 98 organizations here; 31% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
